dedupe_keys.name: residential property price register ireland sales since 2010

description: The Residential Property Price Register lists the date of sale, the price and the address of every residential property bought in Ireland since 1 January 2010, as declared to the Revenue Commissioners for stamp duty. It is kept by the Property Services Regulatory Authority under section 86 of the Property Services (Regulation) Act 2011, and the Authority publishes the declared data without editing it. Coverage: all of Ireland, searchable by county and year, with a commercial property price register kept separately. Access: a search page and a DOWNLOAD ALL zip of CSV files, free and without registration; the register was last updated on 23 September 2026. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the Authority states there are no further particulars such as floor area or number of rooms, so it is not a price index; sales not at full market price are marked with two asterisks; prices of new homes exclude VAT at 13.5 percent; where several apartments are sold for one price, the filer may have entered one address with the total, each address with a share, or all addresses with the total; typing errors made when the stamp duty return was filed appear on the register. Simulation uses are replacement and market value layers for residential exposure models and for housing market inputs to recovery and planning models. Related records: the SEAI Building Energy Rating research tool and the French DVF transactions record for comparison.
